reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically unsound because the equiatomic CoCrFeNiMn (Cantor) alloy is a non-magnetic, single-phase FCC solid solution, so it cannot exhibit a coercive field, and the proposed precipitation mechanism is not expected in this alloy system.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, but it is fundamentally flawed because the baseline material is non-magnetic, making the measurement of a coercive field meaningless and the test incapable of evaluating the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental misunderstanding of the magnetic properties of the chosen alloy, leading researchers down a completely unproductive path.
